rules.rule: TPMO disclosure per 42 CFR 422.2267(e)(41) — persistent site band + carrier-count language blocked until owner confirms counts
rules.verification_note: CORRECTED 2026-09-12 (master audit, verified against eCFR versioner XML 2026-09-08 + 91 FR 17384): the CY2027 final rule DID revise (e)(41) — introductory text and (e)(41)(ii): the SHIP reference is removed from the standardized sentence and the verbal disclaimer timing becomes 'prior to the discussion of any benefits'; applicable to CY2027 marketing beginning 2026-10-01. The COUNTS requirement is unchanged and the site's count-less fallback remains NON-COMPLIANT until the owner/FMO supplies organization/product counts (tpmoConfig.ts, status BLOCKED_COUNTS_REQUIRED). Variant switch is automatic (activeContractYearVariant). 2026-09-28: date switch EXECUTED against src/lib/tpmoConfig.ts via tsx — 2026-09-30T23:59-04:00 → CY2026, 2026-10-01T00:00-04:00 → CY2027. Counts still null (status BLOCKED_COUNTS_REQUIRED) — P1 remains OPEN and becomes more acute with PY2027 marketing (Oct 1) and AEP (Oct 15).

rules.rule: 42 CFR 422.2267(e)(41) as amended by 91 FR 17384 (CY2027 final rule): standardized TPMO sentence without the SHIP reference; verbal disclaimer 'prior to the discussion of any benefits'; counts [organizations]/[products] still mandatory for multi-carrier TPMOs
